title: Job
description: Represents the process of converting a file to another format.

id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the job

key.description: The API key used to create the job

status.description: The current status of the job

sandbox.description: Indicates whether or not the job was processed on the developer sandbox (i.e. at no cost)

created_at.description: The time at which the job was created (UTC in ISO_8601)

finished_at.description: The time at which the job finished if successful, or null otherwise (UTC in ISO_8601)

target_format.description: The name of the format to which source_file is being converted

credit_cost.description: The cost in conversion credits of the job

export_url.description: The location to which all converted files will be copied
